method: Individual English-Chinese sense scope, idiom, POS, target-expression identity, learner example and translation judgment. Independent lexical triage only; original Master full source context and item authorizations not obtained.
policy: All 70 remain Master-first HOLD, including LEXICAL_SUPPORT; no KU release until item-specific Master approvals + individual Muse review. Frozen Core20K/V30/author source untouched.

rows.author_gloss_zh: 重新回到床上；再次上床
rows.author_example_en: I got back into bed for another ten minutes.
rows.author_example_zh: 我又回床上待了十分钟。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: get back into bed并不必然意味着躺下或继续睡，修订宽泛且例句准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 静静坐一会儿；坐着不动片刻
rows.author_example_en: I sat still for a minute before standing up.
rows.author_example_zh: 站起来之前，我静静坐了一会儿。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: sit still重点是不动而非恢复精神；从坐到站前静坐例句准确。

rows.author_example_en: I'm always a little grumpy before breakfast.
rows.author_example_zh: 早餐前我总有点烦躁。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: grumpy是易烦躁/脾气不好，不专指起床气；中文修正正确。

rows.expression: feel like going back to bed
rows.author_gloss_zh: 想回到床上再待一会儿
rows.author_example_en: It's so cold that I feel like going back to bed.
rows.author_example_zh: 天太冷了，我想回床上再躺会儿。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: feel like going back to bed不必强调继续睡觉；回床上待一会儿符合冷天语境。

rows.author_example_en: I brew coffee with freshly ground beans every morning.
rows.author_example_zh: 我每天早晨用现磨咖啡豆冲泡咖啡。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: brew coffee指冲泡或制作咖啡，非必定在锅里煮沸；译文准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 把水壶放上去烧水；打开电水壶
rows.author_example_en: I'll put the kettle on before I take a shower.
rows.author_example_zh: 我洗澡前先把水壶烧上。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: put the kettle on指开始烧水，不必预设泡茶目的；英式语用合理。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 流动的水；水龙头流出的水
rows.author_example_en: Wash your hands under running water.
rows.author_example_zh: 用流动的自来水洗手。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: running water泛指流动水，洗手语境特指水龙头流水可以，但不应约束通用释义。

rows.original_gloss_zh: 用毛巾把头发擦到半干
rows.author_gloss_zh: 用毛巾擦去头发多余水分
rows.author_example_en: I towel-dry my hair before using the hair dryer.
rows.author_example_zh: 用吹风机之前，我先用毛巾吸去头发上多余的水分。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: towel-dry是用毛巾吸走水分，不保证恰好半干；修订自然。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 贴面剃须；刮得很干净的一次剃须
rows.author_example_en: I prefer a close shave before a formal event.
rows.author_example_zh: 正式活动前，我喜欢把胡子刮得很干净。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: close shave的剃须名词义与险些出事的惯用义需分开；当前例句准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 疏通排水口；疏通排水管
rows.author_example_en: We need to unclog the drain before using the shower.
rows.author_example_zh: 使用淋浴前，我们得把排水口疏通。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: drain可指排水口或排水管；unclog为除去堵塞物，修订比下水道更具体。

rows.author_example_en: Please clean up the spilled water before someone slips.
rows.author_example_zh: 请把洒出来的水擦干，免得有人滑倒。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: clean up不限定必须擦干，清理洒出的水较准确；示例可用擦干这种具体方法。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 擦净洒出的污物或液体
rows.author_example_en: I wiped up the mess around the sink.
rows.author_example_zh: 我把洗手池周围洒出的脏东西擦干净了。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: wipe up the mess常指擦净洒漏污物，中文新释义与水槽场景吻合。

rows.original_gloss_zh: 清洗可重复使用的洗脸巾
rows.author_gloss_zh: 清洗可重复使用的布巾
rows.author_example_en: I wash the reusable cloth after cleaning my face.
rows.author_example_zh: 用可重复使用的洗脸巾擦脸后，我会把它洗干净。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: reusable cloth不限洗脸巾，使用场景可示例为洗脸巾但词义不能锁死。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 浅淡柔和色调的；柔和浅色（名词）
rows.author_example_en: She wore a pastel pink cardigan.
rows.author_example_zh: 她穿了一件淡粉色针织开衫。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: pastel形容词与名词两类用法已在中文和说明中区分，pastel pink例句准确。

rows.author_example_en: I packed a lightweight jacket for the trip.
rows.author_example_zh: 旅行时我带了一件轻便夹克。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: lightweight只承诺重量较轻，不暗示面料薄或保暖差；修订正确。

rows.author_example_en: I can't zip up this jacket because it has a broken zipper.
rows.author_example_zh: 这件夹克拉链坏了，我拉不上。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: broken zipper是名词短语'坏掉的拉链'，区别于The zipper is broken谓语表达。

rows.author_example_en: I found a small tear in the fabric near the pocket.
rows.author_example_zh: 我发现口袋旁的布料有一道小破口。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: tear in the fabric是撕裂破口而未必贯穿成洞；中文修订恰当。

rows.author_example_en: I'll pack an extra layer because the evening may be cold.
rows.author_example_zh: 我会多带一层衣服，因为晚上可能冷。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: extra layer未必只能为保暖，可为防风和气温变化；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: Please put away sharp tools after using them.
rows.author_example_zh: 用完锋利工具后请妥善收好。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: 原学习目标是put away sharp tools这一完整动词短语，新中文仅“锋利或尖锐的工具”，遗漏put away的收纳动作。应改“收好锋利或尖锐的工具”，另在用法说明解释sharp。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 松动的电线；未固定的线缆
rows.author_example_en: I tucked the loose cable behind the desk.
rows.author_example_zh: 我把散落的电线收到了书桌后面。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: loose cable可指松动或未固定的电缆，不必散落地面，释义扩展正确；中文例句可保留特定散落情况。

rows.original_gloss_zh: 放在儿童够不到的地方
rows.author_gloss_zh: 避免让儿童接触；放在儿童接触不到的地方
rows.author_example_en: Keep cleaning chemicals away from children.
rows.author_example_zh: 把清洁化学用品放在儿童接触不到的地方。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: keep away from children是避免儿童接触，能以放置远离儿童实现，但不限单一物理动作。

rows.author_example_en: I scrub the sink with a soft brush.
rows.author_example_zh: 我用软刷把水槽刷干净。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: sink既可厨房水槽也可洗手池，按场景双释合理。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 把洗好的衣物挂起来晾干
rows.author_example_en: I hang out the laundry when the weather is dry.
rows.author_example_zh: 天气干燥时我把洗好的衣服挂出去晾。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: hang out the laundry/ washing常为晾挂衣物，原中文新释义添“洗好的”合理语境但非绝对词义；建议“把衣物挂出去晾干”，例句可说明洗后。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 给衣物分类；给待洗衣物分类
rows.author_example_en: I sort the laundry before starting the washing machine.
rows.author_example_zh: 开洗衣机前我先给脏衣服分类。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: sort the laundry可按颜色面料分类待洗衣物，不必均为脏衣，译文清楚。

rows.author_example_en: Please put dishes away after they are dry.
rows.author_example_zh: 碗碟干了之后请放回橱柜。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: put dishes away不必指定橱柜，源英文泛指放回收纳位置。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 更换空气过滤器或滤网
rows.author_example_en: I change the air filter according to the manufacturer's schedule.
rows.author_example_zh: 我按厂家的建议周期更换空气滤芯。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: air filter指滤网或过滤器，未必只有滤芯；修订准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 清洁剂蒸气；刺激性气体
rows.author_example_en: Open the windows if cleaning fumes build up, and leave the area if needed.
rows.author_example_zh: 如果清洁剂气体积聚，就开窗通风，必要时离开现场。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: cleaning fumes可指刺激性蒸气或挥发物，限定具体安全说明适当。

rows.original_gloss_zh: 对宠物相对安全的清洁剂
rows.author_gloss_zh: 适用于有宠物家庭的清洁剂
rows.author_example_en: Choose a pet-safe cleaner and follow its instructions carefully.
rows.author_example_zh: 选择对宠物相对安全的清洁剂，并认真按说明使用。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: pet-safe不代表绝对无毒，修订将适用条件放入说明正确；应保留标签限制。

rows.author_example_en: The drying time is longer on humid days.
rows.author_example_zh: 潮湿天气衣服晾干所需时间更长。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: drying time既可晾干也可烘干，当前潮湿天例句指晾干，译义合理。

rows.author_example_en: This sweater is made of wool and needs gentle care.
rows.author_example_zh: 这件毛衣是羊毛的，需要轻柔护理。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: wool指羊毛、羊毛制面料，不能泛指所有羊毛衣物；例句自然。

rows.author_example_en: I prefer cotton towels because they absorb water well.
rows.author_example_zh: 我更喜欢棉毛巾，因为它们吸水性好。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: cotton在此名词棉纤维或面料、cotton towels作定语，中文范围准确。

rows.original_gloss_zh: 已经渗入织物的旧污渍
rows.author_gloss_zh: 已固定、难以去除的顽固污渍
rows.author_example_en: This old set-in stain may be difficult to remove.
rows.author_example_zh: 这块渗进面料的旧污渍可能很难去除。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: set-in stain含已经固定难去除的污渍，不必旧或深入纤维；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: We plan to roast chicken with potatoes on Sunday.
rows.author_example_zh: 我们计划周日用烤箱烤鸡配土豆。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: roast chicken既可动词roast+chicken又可整体名词'烤鸡'，当前例句仅教动词结构；需Master明确教学Sense及词性身份，不要默改跨Sense解释。

rows.author_example_en: Taste the soup before adding more seasoning.
rows.author_example_zh: 再加调味料前先尝尝汤。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: seasoning可以表示调味品或调味行为，本例adding more seasoning是调味料义；修订限定场景清晰。

rows.author_example_en: Flip the pancakes with a spatula.
rows.author_example_zh: 用锅铲把煎饼翻面。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: spatula包括锅铲和刮刀等，翻煎饼例句符合锅铲义。

rows.author_example_en: The frozen peas are in the freezer.
rows.author_example_zh: 冻豌豆放在冷冻柜里。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: freezer可为冰柜或冰箱冷冻室，不必独立设备；修订正确。

rows.author_example_en: Put the leftover soup in a food container.
rows.author_example_zh: 把剩下的汤放进食物保鲜盒。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: food container泛指食物容器，不保证密封保鲜，中文修改准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 阅读说明；按此场景阅读食谱步骤
rows.author_example_en: Read the instructions before turning on the oven.
rows.author_example_zh: 开烤箱前先读烹饪步骤。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: read the instructions不必是烹饪步骤，在做饭情境可指使用说明或食谱；修订正确。

rows.author_example_en: Keep raw chicken separate from cooked food.
rows.author_example_zh: 生鸡肉要与熟食分开放。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: raw与undercooked不同，生鸡肉例句贴合生食原料义。

rows.author_example_en: The tofu should be firm enough to hold its shape.
rows.author_example_zh: 豆腐要足够结实，才能保持形状。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: firm tofu为紧实或较硬质地，并非一般结构坚固；修订准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 咸鲜的；鲜香的；非甜口的
rows.author_example_en: The mushroom broth has a rich savory taste.
rows.author_example_zh: 蘑菇汤有浓郁的咸鲜风味。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: savory描述咸鲜或非甜口，不能等同很咸；蘑菇汤例句合理。

rows.author_example_en: The vegetables are washed and ready to cook.
rows.author_example_zh: 蔬菜洗好了，可以下锅了。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: ready to cook是准备好烹饪，不必下锅，也可烤箱等方式；修订正确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 查看到期日期；查看标注的失效日期
rows.author_example_en: Check the expiration date before using the packaged ingredient.
rows.author_example_zh: 使用包装食材前查看有效日期。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: expiration date表示到期/失效日期，与best-before、use-by需谨慎区分；中文修订较准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 家里做的一顿饭；家常饭
rows.author_example_en: What a lovely home-cooked meal!
rows.author_example_zh: 这顿家常饭真棒！
rows.independent_semantic_reason: home-cooked meal指一顿在家制作的饭，非单一道菜；翻译改进准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 大汤匙；一大匙（计量单位）
rows.author_example_en: The recipe calls for a tablespoon of olive oil.
rows.author_example_zh: 食谱要求加入一大汤匙橄榄油。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: tablespoon既为餐具大匙也为计量单位，具体体积需按地区约定；译文准确。

rows.author_example_en: There's a pitcher of cold water in the fridge.
rows.author_example_zh: 冰箱里有一壶凉水。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: pitcher在美式通常指带倾倒口的壶，不限冷饮；修订自然。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 往杯中倒入饮料；将杯子装满
rows.author_example_en: Please fill a glass with water for our guest.
rows.author_example_zh: 请给客人倒满一杯水。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: fill a glass通常表示装满杯子或装到预期容量，原中文新释义“往杯中倒入饮料”过宽；建议“把杯子装满；倒满一杯”，保留不一定到杯沿的注释。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 把剩菜收好；妥善存放剩食
rows.author_example_en: Put leftovers away promptly after the meal.
rows.author_example_zh: 饭后及时把剩菜收进冰箱。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: put leftovers away是把剩食收好，未必词义包含冰箱；储存安全另说明合适。

rows.author_gloss_zh: （面包等）放久变陈的；失去原有口感的
rows.author_example_en: The bread has gone stale overnight.
rows.author_example_zh: 面包放了一夜变得不新鲜了。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: stale bread是放久失去鲜软口感，不等于霉变；修订准确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 把晚吃的晚餐重新加热
rows.author_example_en: I'll warm up a late dinner for you when you get home.
rows.author_example_zh: 你回家晚了，我会给你把晚餐热一下。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: warm up a late dinner语义可指加热晚餐，但late dinner和warm up的组合略生硬；作者中文“晚吃的晚餐”不地道。建议“把较晚吃的晚餐热一下”，并核目标是否自然。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 把餐具收好；把碗碟归位
rows.author_example_en: Put dishes away once they are dry.
rows.author_example_zh: 餐具晾干后放回橱柜。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: put dishes away不特指放橱柜，收纳归位词义正确。

rows.author_example_en: There are still dirty dishes in the sink.
rows.author_example_zh: 水槽里还有待洗的脏餐具。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: dishes泛指碗盘餐具，只有dirty dishes才指脏餐具；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: Dry the wooden board after washing.
rows.author_example_zh: 洗完木砧板后晾干。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: wooden board泛指木板，当前厨房例句实际木砧板，宽泛修订可接受，但厨房教学更自然教wooden cutting board，源表达身份须Master核对。

rows.author_example_en: Check that the plastic container is dishwasher-safe.
rows.author_example_zh: 确认塑料盒可用洗碗机清洗。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: plastic container泛指塑料容器，不一定食品保鲜盒；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: Don't use steel wool on a nonstick coating.
rows.author_example_zh: 别用钢丝球擦不粘涂层。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: steel wool是细钢丝棉或擦洗材料，不一定特定球形钢丝球；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: Wipe up the water with a paper towel.
rows.author_example_zh: 用厨房纸巾擦掉洒出的水。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: paper towel可作厨房用及其他吸水擦拭纸巾，非仅厨房场景；修订正确。

rows.author_example_en: Use a surface cleaner suitable for the countertop.
rows.author_example_zh: 使用适合台面的表面清洁剂。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: surface cleaner是表面清洁剂，台面仅其中一种适用表面；修订正确。

rows.author_example_en: Replace the bin liner when you empty the rubbish.
rows.author_example_zh: 倒垃圾后换一个垃圾袋。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: bin liner是垃圾桶内衬袋，较泛化垃圾袋更具体；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: Squirt some dish soap onto the sponge, then scrub the greasy pan.
rows.author_example_zh: 往海绵上挤一点洗洁精，再刷洗油腻的锅。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: squirt on dish soap作为独立教学表达不自然，新例句变成Squirt some dish soap onto the sponge。原目标与例句不一致，须Master重新核定完整目标。

rows.author_example_en: I emptied the debris trap and cleaned the dishwasher filter as directed.
rows.author_example_zh: 我按说明倒空了集污槽，并清洁了洗碗机滤网。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: empty the filter并非一般洗碗机清洁表达，新例句已改成emptied the debris trap and cleaned the dishwasher filter，目标未出现。须Master确认滤网/集污盒是否混淆。

rows.author_example_en: Replace the bin liner with a fresh bag.
rows.author_example_zh: 换一个新的垃圾袋。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: replace the bin liner是更换垃圾桶内部的衬袋，比更换普通垃圾袋更精确。

rows.author_gloss_zh: 烧焦并粘牢的；焦结在表面的
rows.author_example_en: Soak the burnt-on food before scrubbing.
rows.author_example_zh: 先浸泡烧结的食物残渣再刷洗。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: burnt-on指烧焦粘牢在锅具上的残渣，不是技术烧结；修订较自然。

rows.author_example_en: The glasses look cloudy even after washing.
rows.author_example_zh: 玻璃杯洗过后仍显得发雾。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: cloudy glasses为玻璃雾蒙蒙，cloudy也可指液体浑浊；修订范围正确。

rows.author_example_en: We should replace this damaged nonstick pan.
rows.author_example_zh: 这口涂层损坏的不粘锅该换了。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: damaged nonstick pan只表示不粘锅受损，不必肯定是涂层损坏；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: Use a plunger only if it's suitable for this drain.
rows.author_example_zh: 只有适合这种排水口时才用皮搋子疏通。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: use a plunger本身只指使用皮搋子；具体用途与设备须由语境说明。

rows.author_example_en: Turn on the lamp next to the sofa, please.
rows.author_example_zh: 请把沙发旁的台灯打开。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: lamp泛指灯具，不仅台灯，靠沙发的灯是语境实例。

rows.author_example_en: I'm going to take a nap before dinner.
rows.author_example_zh: 晚饭前我打算小睡一会儿。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: take a nap为短暂小睡，任何时间均可，非只午睡。

rows.author_example_en: The bright light kept me awake.
rows.author_example_zh: 刺眼的灯光让我睡不着。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: bright light是明亮/强烈的光，不必刺眼；修订准确。

rows.author_example_en: We opened the window to air out the stuffy room.
rows.author_example_zh: 我们打开窗户给闷热的房间通风。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: stuffy room表示空气闷、不流通而不必闷热；中文主释义正确，但例句译文仍写“闷热的房间”，建议“憋闷不通风的房间”。

rows.author_example_en: Turn off notifications during your break.
rows.author_example_zh: 休息时关掉消息通知。
rows.independent_semantic_reason: turn off notifications与switch off notifications在同场景可能同一学习目标；须真实对照第二KU身份，不凭同义描述直接重复或删除。
